boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Oklahoma-Norman Campus, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure Friday-to-Sunday route for learning the Norman campus, finding useful spaces, and sampling nearby public destinations.

cards.title: Start with campus orientation
cards.subtitle: Friday morning · Parrington Oval
cards.notes: Pick up campus information at Jacobson Hall, then use the visitor resources to plan the rest of your walking route.
cards.short_summary: Begin with the university’s designated starting point for campus visitors.
cards.evidence_claim: OU identifies the Jones Family Welcome Center at Jacobson Hall as the place where a campus visit begins.
cards.access_notes: OU notes that prospective students and guests need a parking permit while visiting campus.

cards.title: Set out on a self-guided loop
cards.subtitle: Friday morning · Norman campus
cards.notes: Use OU’s self-guided tour as a loose route, pausing at the landmarks that catch your attention instead of trying to rush every stop.
cards.short_summary: A flexible, official way to make the campus layout familiar.
cards.evidence_claim: OU offers a self-guided campus tour and an augmented-reality tour experience for visitors.
cards.access_notes: Bring a phone if using the augmented-reality option; follow posted building-access rules.

cards.title: Cross the South Oval
cards.subtitle: Friday midday · central Norman campus
cards.notes: Walk across the central green space, note the paths that connect your buildings, and save a landmark photo for easier navigation later.
cards.short_summary: An open-campus pause that helps turn the map into a mental layout.
cards.evidence_claim: OU describes the South Oval, formally Van Vleet Oval, as the central green space on its Norman campus.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space; use marked walkways and check weather conditions before lingering.

cards.title: Find a future study base
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · 401 W. Brooks St.
cards.notes: Go inside, locate the circulation desk and floor maps, then take a quiet look at the Helmerich Great Reading Room.
cards.short_summary: A practical first look at a major campus library and its study settings.
cards.evidence_claim: Bizzell Memorial Library offers floor maps, computers, Wi-Fi, printing, study spaces, and the Helmerich Great Reading Room.
cards.access_notes: The Great Reading Room is on the second floor; use the south-side elevator for step-free access.

cards.entity_name: Fred Jones Jr. Museum of Art
cards.title: Spend an hour with the galleries
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · 555 Elm Ave.
cards.notes: Check the current exhibitions, choose one gallery to explore slowly, and keep your OU ID handy at admission.
cards.short_summary: A campus art stop with publicly listed weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum lists Tuesday–Saturday hours of 10 a.m.–5 p.m., Sunday hours of 1–5 p.m., and free admission for OU students.
cards.source_title: Adult Admission Fee Returns at Fred Jones Jr. Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Closed Mondays; OU students should bring current university identification.

cards.title: Locate the Union’s useful basics
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · 900 Asp Ave.
cards.notes: Walk through the building, identify meeting spaces and services, and check the events calendar before choosing a later activity.
cards.short_summary: A central place to orient yourself to campus services and programming.
cards.evidence_claim: OU states that the Oklahoma Memorial Union hosts events, restaurants, merchants, offices, and student-focused services.
cards.access_notes: The building is open 24 hours, but after midnight Sooner Card access is required at the South and East entrances.

cards.title: Take an early evening neighborhood walk
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Campus Corner, beside OU
cards.notes: Walk the historic district in daylight, note practical shops and food options, and decide which places fit your own budget and needs.
cards.short_summary: A nearby commercial district to get acquainted with beyond campus.
cards.evidence_claim: VisitNorman identifies historic Campus Corner as a Norman district with restaurants and shopping.
cards.access_notes: Choose individual businesses based on their posted access rules and prices; this card does not include bars.

cards.entity_name: Sam Noble Oklahoma Museum of Natural History
cards.title: Make Saturday a museum morning
cards.subtitle: Saturday · 2401 Chautauqua Ave.
cards.notes: Arrive during listed public hours, pick a gallery that interests you, and ask the welcome desk about temporary-exhibit photography rules.
cards.short_summary: A campus museum visit focused on natural-history collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Sam Noble Museum lists Tuesday–Saturday hours of 10 a.m.–5 p.m., Sunday hours of 1–5 p.m., and free admission for OU students.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit - Sam Noble Museum
cards.access_notes: Bring OU ID for free student admission; tickets are otherwise sold at the front desk.

cards.title: Reserve a weather-center tour for Friday
cards.subtitle: Weekday option · National Weather Center
cards.notes: If your first weekend begins Friday, reserve ahead and arrive on time; tours have security requirements and do not accept walk-ins.
cards.short_summary: A reservation-only public tour that offers a science-focused campus-area activity.
cards.evidence_claim: National Weather Center public tours are free, require reservations, run on weekdays, and typically include the observation deck and weather agencies.
cards.access_notes: Tours are usually Monday at 10 a.m. or Friday at 2:30 p.m.; reserve 2–4 weeks ahead because walk-ins are not permitted.

cards.title: Close Sunday with a park loop
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · 201 W. Daws St., Norman
cards.notes: Take the jogging and walking course at an easy pace, then use the picnic areas or amphitheater surroundings for a low-key reset.
cards.short_summary: A city park stop with walking and outdoor recreation amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Norman lists Andrews Park amenities including a jogging/walking course, picnic areas, basketball courts, skate park, and amphitheater.
cards.access_notes: Stay outside any active construction areas and follow posted park rules; reservable facilities have separate fees.
